description:
Submission-beluga is an open-source optimal control software that uses publicly available indirect methods to model inequality constraints at boundaries. This release of beluga introduces a method known as UTM, modified handling of constraints to support the UTM method, and includes bug fixes and related requirements changes.SAND2020-12847 M
